description: Grok Bot's official .deb, by its package and its desktop entry.
why: One install writes both values, so must_find alone would pass with either broken; require_rows names the deb and the desktop entry each. Cursor is forbidden because Anysphere builds both and both ship a deb and a .desktop file, and Grok Build because both carry the Grok name.
known_gaps: The rpm family is not installed: the rpm cursor.com/download/bot links was not served on 2026-11-16.
The AppImage, the feed's own download, leaves no package record and no .desktop file unless the user integrates it.
A match says the Grok Bot app is installed, not that a Bot ran or that a plan includes it.
